text:
rachel: Quick broadcast for this week's release train. Two items: tightened freeze policy for sensitive infra changes, and a short canary tomorrow 16:00 UTC.

tony: what triggered the tighter freeze?

rachel: follow-on from the DB schema drift incident on Friday. Postmortem recommended a pause window for any schema or cache infra changes until we finish the migration-divider rollout.

noah: timeline for the pause? is it across all services?

rachel: Effective immediately: for the next 72h (until 16:00 UTC in three days) no schema, cache infra, or KV contract changes without an explicit freeze-exception signed by @rachel and @anya. Non-breaking bugfixes and docs are OK.

anya: I'll chair exceptions. Please open a PR labeled "freeze-exception" and add the required checklist. Expect a 2hr review SLA.

tony: how do we request emergency rollback or hotfixes during the pause?

rachel: Emergency hotfix flow: tag PR + post in this thread, ping @anya + #eng-oncall. We will run a quick risk review and, if necessary, schedule a targeted canary slot.

deploy-bot: [info] Canary slot reserved: 2026-06-02 16:00:00 UTC. Slot duration: 1h. Auto-rollback triggers: 5xx_rate>0.7% or p95 latency >30% baseline.

noah: will the canary include runtime changes? we've got a serving-runtime tweak queued.

rachel: Serving-runtime tweaks are allowed but must avoid simultaneous cache infra updates. Deploy order will be: control-plane -> serving-runtime -> frontend. No cache infra in the same window.

ops-bot: [reminder] New policy note: all schema migrations must include data-dog migration metrics and a dry-run plan. See policy: /policies/migrations.

anya: For teams with rolling migrations, please coordinate a migration-divider flag and include a rollback path in the PR description.

noah: Understood. I'll add the divider flag to our migration PR and link the metrics dashboards.

rachel: ACTIONS: 1) All teams with schema/cache/kv work - hold merges until exception approved. 2) Owners of queued runtime fixes - confirm you can defer to tomorrow canary or mark urgent. 3) Oncall - watch p50/p95, 5xx, cache-miss, and DB write latency.

tony: I'll mark our runtime fix as deferred to the canary.

deploy-bot: [notice] Auto-hold enforced for PRs touching schema/* or cache/* paths until 1951499199. To request exception, comment `@rachel please-exempt` on the PR.

noah: small question - does this affect scheduled canaries for non-prod?

rachel: Non-prod canaries ok for testing, but do not promote to prod unless exception approved.

oncall-bot: [postmortem link] DB schema drift: root cause = missing nullability check in migration, impact = increased write errors for ~8m. Draft: /linked/postmortems/db-drift-2026-05-30.

anya: I'll run the exception queue morning batch at 09:30 UTC. If you need priority handling, DM me.

rachel: Thanks all. We know this is friction but it's targeted to reduce risk while the migration-divider rollouts complete. Keep updates here and in #eng-oncall during the canary. :white_check_mark:
